title: Slug Generator
description: Takes a string and returns a URL-safe slug by converting to lowercase, removing accents, replacing spaces and special characters with hyphens, and handling camelCase splitting.

string.description: The text to convert to a slug

separator.description: Character(s) to use as word separator (default: '-')

customReplacements.description: Array of [find, replace] pairs for custom character replacements

preserveCharacters.description: Array of characters to preserve in the slug
